game.title: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild
game.notes: Genesis Mode — Nintendo-exclusive, no native achievement list exists on Wii U, Switch, or Switch 2. At the user's explicit request, the official paid Expansion Pass is included as two `dlc`-style bonus lists (Rule 14: The Master Trials, The Champions' Ballad), never affecting the base Platinum. Content is treated as identical between Switch and Switch 2 — a dedicated re-verification pass confirmed no Switch-2-exclusive gameplay feature exists (only performance improvements, a second save slot, and a companion smartphone app), unlike Metroid Prime 4: Beyond's genuine hardware-exclusive control scheme, so no separate Switch-2 bonus pack was built. Initial research hit a shared search-tool budget exhaustion that left several facts unresolved or conflicting; a follow-up re-verification pass resolved nearly all of them, including two corrections to the original research brief: the Champions' Ballad's four per-character questlines are given by Sheikah Monk Monuments via quests named 'EX Champion [Name]'s Song', not by the champion descendants (Teba/Riju/Yunobo/Sidon, who are flavor-only NPCs); and Eventide Island's actual base-game challenge is the 'Stranded on Eventide' shrine quest (place 3 Ancient Orbs), not a chest-hunting NPC as originally assumed. Exact Hyrule Compendium and Korok Seed totals are well-confirmed (385/394 entries, 900 seeds) but the Compendium menu itself shows no numeric readout, so its trophy verifies via visual full-completion instead of a cited number. Whether an in-game 'Divine Beasts freed' counter exists could not be resolved even after re-verification (the two re-verification passes disagreed with each other), so that trophy instead verifies via all four Champion abilities appearing in the item menu, which is confirmed. Post-audit fix (round 1): the Korok Seed trophy originally required all 900 seeds, but the dossier confirms only 441 are needed to fully expand every Weapon/Bow/Shield inventory slot — the remaining ~459 have no mechanical benefit, and collecting all 900 is a well-known, self-aware joke reward in the game's own design (Hestu's Gift). 'Full Stock' (Silver) now caps at the 441-seed practical threshold. Post-audit fix (round 2): 'Uncharted No More' originally required 100% on the map completion percentage, but that stat is 72%-weighted toward Korok Seeds, meaning literal 100% is mathematically impossible without all 900 seeds — this silently reintroduced the exact grind 'Full Stock' was fixed to avoid, so citing the percentage as 'the game's own metric' wasn't sufficient justification on its own (an auditor correctly rejected this reasoning in round 2). 'Uncharted No More' was rebuilt around discovering every named location on the world map instead — a genuinely explorative goal, directly verifiable (every location name is revealed on the map, no percentage or Korok count involved), with no grind-for-its-own-sake component.

trophies.name: Awakening
trophies.description: Complete the Great Plateau, obtaining the Paraglider.
trophies.verification: The Paraglider appears in the item wheel, and Link is free to leave the Great Plateau.

trophies.name: Trial Complete
trophies.description: Complete your first Shrine of Trials outside the Great Plateau.
trophies.verification: The shrine is marked completed on the world map, and a Spirit Orb is added to the inventory.

trophies.name: A Growing Legend
trophies.description: Find your first Korok Seed.
trophies.verification: The seed is added to the Key Items inventory.

trophies.name: Shutterbug
trophies.description: Register your first entry in the Hyrule Compendium.
trophies.verification: The entry appears filled in the Compendium menu.

trophies.name: Blossoming
trophies.description: Unlock your first Great Fairy Fountain.
trophies.verification: The Great Fairy emerges from the fountain and offers her armor upgrade services.

trophies.name: Fashionably Late
trophies.description: Tame and register your first horse at a Stable.
trophies.verification: The horse can be summoned or retrieved from any Stable.

trophies.name: First Course
trophies.description: Cook your first meal at a cooking pot.
trophies.verification: The cooked dish appears in the inventory.

trophies.name: Elixir of Choice
trophies.description: Brew your first elixir by combining a monster part with a critter at a cooking pot.
trophies.verification: The elixir appears in the inventory.

trophies.name: Master Kohga's Defeat
trophies.description: Defeat Master Kohga, leader of the Yiga Clan, at their Hideout in Gerudo Desert.
trophies.verification: Master Kohga's defeat grants access to a treasure chest at the Hideout containing the Thunder Helm.

trophies.name: Champion of the Zora
trophies.description: Free Divine Beast Vah Ruta by defeating Waterblight Ganon.
trophies.verification: Mipha's Grace appears in the item menu, and Vah Ruta is marked freed on the world map.

trophies.name: Champion of the Gorons
trophies.description: Free Divine Beast Vah Rudania by defeating Fireblight Ganon.
trophies.verification: Daruk's Protection appears in the item menu, and Vah Rudania is marked freed on the world map.

trophies.name: Champion of the Gerudo
trophies.description: Free Divine Beast Vah Naboris by defeating Thunderblight Ganon.
trophies.verification: Urbosa's Fury appears in the item menu, and Vah Naboris is marked freed on the world map.

trophies.name: Champion of the Rito
trophies.description: Free Divine Beast Vah Medoh by defeating Windblight Ganon.
trophies.verification: Revali's Gale appears in the item menu, and Vah Medoh is marked freed on the world map.

trophies.name: A Complete Picture
trophies.description: Complete the Captured Memories quest by finding all twelve photograph-based memories.
trophies.verification: The Captured Memories quest is marked complete in the Adventure Log.

trophies.name: Full Bloom
trophies.description: Unlock all four Great Fairy Fountains.
trophies.verification: Every Great Fairy is active at her fountain, and all four offer their armor upgrade services.

trophies.name: Eventide's Trial
trophies.description: Complete the "Stranded on Eventide" shrine quest, placing all three Ancient Orbs while stripped of your gear.
trophies.verification: The shrine quest is marked complete in the Adventure Log, and the island's shrine becomes accessible.

trophies.name: Hero of the Wild
trophies.description: Pull the Master Sword from its pedestal in the Korok Forest.
trophies.verification: The Master Sword appears in the weapon inventory.

trophies.name: A Deadly Duel
trophies.description: Defeat a Lynel.
trophies.verification: The Lynel's defeat is confirmed by the materials it drops.

trophies.name: Liberator of Hyrule
trophies.description: Free all four Divine Beasts.
trophies.verification: All four Champion abilities — Mipha's Grace, Daruk's Protection, Urbosa's Fury, and Revali's Gale — appear together in the item menu.

trophies.name: The Calamity's End
trophies.description: Defeat Calamity Ganon and Dark Beast Ganon, completing the main story.
trophies.verification: The ending cutscene plays and the credits roll.

trophies.name: Master of Shrines
trophies.description: Complete every Shrine of Trials in the base game.
trophies.verification: The shrine-completion count on the save-file loading screen reaches its maximum, and no shrine icon remains uncompleted on the world map.

trophies.name: Full Stock
trophies.description: Find enough Korok Seeds to fully expand your Weapon, Bow, and Shield inventory slots with Hestu.
trophies.verification: Hestu confirms all three inventory categories are fully expanded.

trophies.name: Master Compendium
trophies.description: Fill every entry in the Hyrule Compendium.
trophies.verification: Every category page in the Compendium shows no empty silhouette slots remaining.

trophies.name: Uncharted No More
trophies.description: Discover the name of every named location on the Hyrule map by traveling to each one.
trophies.verification: Every location's name is revealed and legible on the world map — none remain unnamed.

trophies.name: The Legend Reborn
trophies.description: Earn every other trophy.
trophies.verification: All other trophies earned.

trophies.name: Recorded History
trophies.description: View your Hero's Path recorded on the Sheikah Slate map for the first time.
trophies.verification: The green Hero's Path line appears overlaid on the Sheikah Slate map.

trophies.name: Somewhere to Go
trophies.description: Obtain the Travel Medallion.
trophies.verification: The Travel Medallion appears in the Key Items inventory.

trophies.name: Trial by Fire
trophies.description: Clear the Beginning Trials of the Trial of the Sword.
trophies.verification: The Beginning Trials' final chamber is reached and cleared.

trophies.name: Legendary Wardrobe
trophies.description: Obtain all four Master Trials armor sets — Majora's Mask, Midna's Helmet, the Phantom armor set, and the Korok Mask — through their treasure-hunt side quests.
trophies.verification: All four items appear in the armor/mask inventory.

trophies.name: Trial's End
trophies.description: Complete the entire Trial of the Sword, permanently awakening the Master Sword.
trophies.verification: The Master Sword glows permanently without needing to be near enemies, and its Sword Beam no longer depletes its energy.

trophies.name: Golden Hour
trophies.description: Defeat a Golden-tier enemy while playing in Master Mode.
trophies.verification: The enemy's defeat is confirmed during active Master Mode play, indicated by the Triforce icon on-screen.

trophies.name: An Old Melody
trophies.description: Begin The Champions' Ballad by inserting the Sheikah Slate into the pedestal at the Shrine of Resurrection.
trophies.verification: Monk Maz Koshia appears and grants the One-Hit Obliterator.

trophies.name: Hidden Trials
trophies.description: Discover your first Trial-unlocked hidden shrine within an EX Champion Song questline.
trophies.verification: The shrine appears on the world map and is marked completed.

trophies.name: One-Hit Wonder
trophies.description: Clear all four Monster Strongholds using the One-Hit Obliterator.
trophies.verification: The Obliterator splits into four orbs, and Monuments rise across Hyrule.

trophies.name: Ride On
trophies.description: Obtain the Master Cycle Zero.
trophies.verification: The Master Cycle Zero can be summoned from the item menu.

trophies.name: Songs of the Champions
trophies.description: Complete all four EX Champion Song questlines — Revali's, Mipha's, Daruk's, and Urbosa's — earning every Divine Beast Emblem.
trophies.verification: All four EX Champion Song quests are marked complete in the Adventure Log, and every Emblem appears in the Key Items inventory.

trophies.name: The Final Trial
trophies.description: Complete the Final Trial beneath the Shrine of Resurrection and defeat Monk Maz Koshia.
trophies.verification: Monk Maz Koshia's defeat triggers The Champions' Ballad's ending cutscene.
